cohort: A 52-year-old woman with adenomyosis who had three failed frozen embryo transfers (FETs) and subsequently received 6 months of GnRHa therapy.
finding: GnRHa therapy in a patient with adenomyosis led to successful twin live birth after FET, but was complicated by extensive placenta accreta requiring cesarean hysterectomy.
mod_finding: The delivery was complicated by expansive accretas of both placentas requiring cesarean hysterectomy.
